periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation tilted approximately 45 degrees downward toward the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval geometry with a high aspect ratio, length being approximately twice the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate tapering observed at the anterior-inferior portion of the patch toward the snout.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shaped profile at the posterior margin of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band occupies approximately one-third of the total visible body length in lateral profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are positioned laterally with a wide inter-pinna gap roughly equal to the width of the ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded semicircular apex on both visible ear structures.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct gradient in the white pelage from bright white on the neck and shoulders to a yellowish-cream hue on the posterior and lumbar regions.
